fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank’s policy.

llm_raw_reply: Axis Magnus Credit Card looks like the best fit for your travel spend – it nets about ₹33k a year in savings and isn’t invitation‑only. The top‑ranked Axis Burgundy Magnus would save more, but you can’t apply for it directly. The SBI Landmark card’s big savings come mainly from a milestone that’s likely over‑valued, so the real benefit may be lower.
